now_extension.what: ESA formally ADOPTS the LISA mission (launch ~2035, Ariane 6): the mHz gravitational-wave window — massive-black-hole mergers across cosmic history — moves from concept to funded construction. The seam's empirical arena keeps growing.

LHAASO GRB 221009A Lorentz-invariance-violation constraints published (JCAP 04(2024)060; arXiv:2402.06009): linear-LIV quantum-gravity energy scale bounded ABOVE ~10x the Planck energy — QG phenomenology (the ~1997 action-space) now delivering real super-Planckian bounds.

Tobar-Manikandan-Beitel-Pikovski (Nature Communications 2024): single-GRAVITON detection via quantum sensing (acoustic resonator + superfluid He, gravito-phononic ground state) argued feasible in near-future experiments — face (1) of the seam S edges toward the lab.

Oppenheim's 'postquantum theory of classical gravity' (PRX 13, 041040, Dec 2023) mainstreams through 2024 (APS Physics viewpoint; PBS Spacetime Aug 2024): consistent CLASSICAL spacetime + quantum matter via stochastic metric fluctuations, with a decoherence-vs-diffusion experimental trade-off — the Rosenfeld semiclassical DISSENT line revived as a testable rival.

UN/UNESCO International Year of Quantum Science and Technology opens in Paris (4-5 Feb 2025): the W_B parent's CENTENARY (Heisenberg's 1925 Umdeutung) — parent turns 100 with the weld still unconsummated.

General Relativity turns 110 (Nov 1915 field equations): the W_A parent's anniversary anchor — the seam first noticed 1916 is now ~109-110 years open, the longest-running unconsummated weld in the dataset.
Laser-interferometric proposal to measure graviton-scale energy exchange between light and the gravitational field (phys.org Dec 2025): a second independent route to single-graviton signatures.

Holography canopy stays the most active growth: celestial-holography results (Nordita 2026) and the 'Black Hole Horizons and Beyond' workshop (Durham, July 2026) on singularities/interiors via dual QFTs — the grandchild keeps outgrowing the unborn child.

General Relativity (Einstein 1915).basis: Estimate (confidence 0.5): every candidate must reproduce GR as the IR limit (base survived[]), and GR's background-independence is the canonical line's primary commitment; historiographic consensus that the geometric kernel is one of two co-equal load-bearing halves.

Quantum Mechanics / Quantum Field Theory.basis: Estimate (confidence 0.5): mirror requirement — exact QFT recovery in the flat/no-gravity limit, operator/probabilistic kernel, and the covariant line's entire perturbative machinery; co-equal with GR by the same consensus.

novel_residue.basis: Estimate (confidence 0.5): the joint-only products neither parent contains — problem of time, S=A/4 area-law compression, discrete area/volume spectra, spacetime-from-entanglement holography. PROSPECTIVE residue: it measures what the search has surfaced, since the child itself is unborn; disclosed proxy, not measured synergy bits.
